# MUS-W-0010

**The intake surface**

work-unit · 2026-08-20

Discharges: [MUS-M-0004](../milestones.md#mus-m-0004)

Decided by: [MUS-D-0038](../decisions.md#mus-d-0038), [MUS-D-0039](../decisions.md#mus-d-0039)

## Context

One box, reachable over HTTP, that turns a line of text into a finding record without asking for anything else.

## Depends on

MUS-W-0011, the write path.

## Discharges

Part of MUS-M-0004: a jot lands in Mustur's findings-queue, carries a routing hint where one is obvious, and defaults to the idea inbox where it is not.

## Done means

Filing takes the text and nothing else: no title, no destination, no confirmation step.
A jot naming exactly one routing record is routed to it; one naming none, or more than one that do not contain each other, goes to the record declaring itself the default.
Every filed record says where it went and why in its own words, including which destinations an ambiguous jot named.
Filing is post-redirect-get, so a phone reloading after a dropped connection does not file the same jot twice.
An empty jot is refused with the page returned rather than redirected, so what was typed is not lost.
The recency list reads the log's own timestamps, not the records' dates, because a record's date is accurate to the day and the question is about the hour.

## Risks

This is reachable off the home network as of 2026-08-21: mustur.devofpie.com, on LinkCtrl's tunnel, behind a Cloudflare Access application. The identity header the surface trusts is set by Access at the edge, and a forged one buys nothing because Access answers before the origin is consulted, checked 2026-08-21. What that leaves unproven is the milestone's own wording — a jot from a phone — which only the owner can test, because only the owner can get through Access.
The loopback guard in serve is what keeps the tunnel the only way in, and it is a guard rail rather than security: publish the port by any other route and anything reaching it can claim to be anyone. Whatever publishes it has to carry the identity.
Word-boundary matching is a heuristic. A jot about a repository it never names goes to the inbox, which is the failure the design accepts: a wrong route is worse than an unrouted jot, because nobody re-reads the inbox looking for things that were filed correctly.
